title: Local finite-free chain representative of a universally free lowest truncation
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and K a perfect object [def-pc-perfect-complex] of D(O_S) [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose every derived pullback Lk*K [def-pc-derived-pullback] has zero cohomology in every negative degree. Suppose each point of S has an open U0 and an integer r >= 0 such that H0(L(k >> U0.ι)*K) is finite locally free of rank r [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] for every scheme Y and k:Y -> U0. Let M be an O_S-module and a:M[0] -> K a derived arrow with H0(a) invertible. For every point s of S there is an open U containing s, strictly perfect complexes A and B of modules on its localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], a chain map alpha:A -> B, and isomorphisms eA:(M[0])|U -> Q(A), eB:K|U -> Q(B). Every term A^i for i != 0 and B^i for i < 0 is zero, B.d(0,1)=0, alpha^0 is invertible, and a|U followed by eB equals eA followed by Q(alpha). The isomorphisms relate the specified arrow, not just its endpoints.

proof.text: Apply perfect_universalH0_bottom_model to choose an affine neighbourhood U and strictly perfect B with zero negative terms, zero d(0,1), and eB:K|U~Q(B). This isolates exactly the original residue-model and square-matrix steps, with no source module or arrow.

Exact restriction F commutes with derived homology by the proved upstream mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso. Transport the given H0(a) isomorphism through this comparison, the single-functor homology isomorphism, eB, homologyFunctorFactors, and the ofZeros homology data for B.sc(0). This constructs eM:F(M)~B^0. Define A explicitly as the single complex on B^0. Transfer the finite-free retract for B^0 to A^0; all other terms are zero. The exact restriction/single-functor comparison, single(eM), and singleFunctorIsoCompQ construct eA:(M[0])|U~Q(A).
Conjugate the specified restricted a by eA.inv and eB.hom. Apply perfect_affine_map_representative to obtain alpha with Q(alpha)=eA.inv >> a|U >> eB.hom.

The conjugated arrow is invertible on degree-zero homology. Naturality of homologyFunctorFactors transfers this to homologyMap(alpha,0). Since both short complexes at zero have zero incoming and outgoing maps, LeftHomologyMapData.ofZeros expresses their homology map as an iso followed by alpha.f(0) followed by an iso. Cancel these isomorphisms to show alpha.f(0) is invertible. Finally substitute Q(alpha) and cancel eA.hom >> eA.inv to obtain the required square.

theorem perfect_universalH0_local_chain_model
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hK : IsPerfect S K)
    (hnegative : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ S) (i : ℤ), i < 0 →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) i).obj
          ((derivedPullback k).obj K)))
    (hloc : ∀ s : S, ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ,
      ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ U.toScheme),
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((derivedPullback (k ≫ U.ι)).obj K)) r)
    (M : S.Modules)
    (a : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M ⟶ K)
    (ha : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).map a))
    (s : S) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧
      ∃ A B : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ,
        IsStrictlyPerfect S U A ∧ IsStrictlyPerfect S U B ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ 0 → IsZero (A.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (B.X i)) ∧ B.d 0 1 = 0 ∧
        ∃ α : A ⟶ B, IsIso (α.f 0) ∧
          ∃ (eA : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
                (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M) ≅
                DerivedCategory.Q.obj A)
            (eB : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
                (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅
                DerivedCategory.Q.obj B),
            (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
              (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map a ≫ eB.hom =
                eA.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map α
